3. Use the buttons on the right to:
Here are some hints to help you:
• Petals are the colorful parts that attract pollinators
• Sepals protect the flower bud before it opens
• Stamens are the male reproductive parts (anther + filament)
• Pistil is the female reproductive part (stigma + style + ovary)
• The receptacle is the part where all flower parts attach
Here's how to check your answers:
